column1: # Observed licence string to archive tier. A tier governs publication only, never whether a
# source is fetched. Three kinds of row, and the licence column is the lookup key for all
# three: one row per distinct value of attributes.licence on a source record; one row per
# distinct string a metadata service serves that is the same licence spelled differently;
# and one row per string a metadata service serves that no record carries and that the
# A spelling row carries the family and tier of the row it is read as a spelling of, and
# its note names that row and the date it was read. A ruling row names the ruling and its
# date in its note, because no earlier row states its reading. Nothing is normalised at
# Hand reviewed, not generated: tests/licence-map.test.ts fails the build when the store
# carries a licence string with no row here. A source with no licence string at all takes
# t4-private by default and appears in the licence triage queue.
